title: My Town
text:
My town is in the mountains. There is a river in the valley. In summer, there are many green forests and fields. The lake is big and clean.

The town has a small airport. Tourists come to walk in the hills. In winter, the hills are white with snow. People like to ski there.

questions.text: What do tourists come to do in the hills?
What kind of place is the town most likely to be?
options: A place with mountains and nature
A big city with no hills

questions.text: Which season is the best for skiing in the hills?

vocabulary.definition: a low area of land between hills or mountains
large areas of land covered with grass or crops
a large area of water surrounded by land
people who travel to visit a place
very high areas of land with steep sides

paragraph_translations: Моє місто знаходиться в горах. У долині є річка. Влітку там багато зелених лісів і полів. Озеро велике і чисте.
У місті є невеликий аеропорт. Туристи приходять, щоб гуляти по пагорбах. Взимку пагорби білі від снігу. Люди люблять кататися там на лижах.
